desc:
Mix it up. Solve it. Race your friends!

Never solved a cube? A friendly voice coach teaches you the 2x2 and 3x3 step by step, on your own cube. You learn WHY each move works, so you can solve it on your own, not just copy.

WHAT'S INSIDE
• Learn to solve: guided lessons with a voice coach
• Learn the moves: what R, U and F mean
• 3 puzzles: Pyramid (easiest), 2x2 and 3x3
• Timed solves: beat your best time
• Daily puzzle: a new challenge every day
• Leaderboards with replays: watch how the top times were solved
• Race live: 1v1 vs a friend or a player at your level, or race a ghost any time
• Stuck? Get help from where you are, or watch it solve itself

CONTROLS
Swipe a layer to turn it, drag around the cube to look. Made for phones, great on tablet and PC (move pad and keyboard shortcuts too).

New puzzles and lessons are coming. Like and favorite to get the updates!

Cubes: Pyramid, Pyraminx, Skewb, 3x3x1, 3x3, 2x2, 2x2x3, 3x3x2, Leaf, 4x4, 5x5, Mirror Cube
